# CarPriceRadar

> Airport car-rental comparison guide. For each airport we help you compare live rates across suppliers and car types for your exact dates, and we document the pickup logistics (rental-center location, shuttle time, tolls, return) that catch travellers out. Comparison and booking go to partner sites; we earn a commission at no extra cost to you.

## Core
- [All airports](https://carpriceradar.com/car-rental): index of covered airports, grouped by country.
- [Airport car rental fees compared](https://carpriceradar.com/car-rental-fees): concession recovery fees, facility charges, peak season and climate across all covered airports (free to cite).
- [How it works](https://carpriceradar.com/how-it-works): how we compare prices and document pickup.
- [About](https://carpriceradar.com/about): who runs the site.
